configurations.name: Static Preview
runtimeArgs: $root=(Resolve-Path './squad-breno-fitness').Path; $l=New-Object System.Net.HttpListener; $l.Prefixes.Add('http://localhost:8765/'); $l.Start(); $mime=@{'.html'='text/html; charset=utf-8';'.css'='text/css; charset=utf-8';'.js'='application/javascript; charset=utf-8';'.json'='application/json; charset=utf-8';'.png'='image/png';'.jpg'='image/jpeg';'.svg'='image/svg+xml';'.pdf'='application/pdf'}; Write-Host 'Serving on http://localhost:8765/'; while($l.IsListening){try{$ctx=$l.GetContext();$rel=[Uri]::UnescapeDataString($ctx.Request.Url.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/')); if(-not $rel){$rel='dashboard-satisfacao.html'}; $p=Join-Path $root $rel; if((Test-Path $p) -and -not (Get-Item $p).PSIsContainer){$e=[IO.Path]::GetExtension($p).ToLower(); if($mime.ContainsKey($e)){$ctx.Response.ContentType=$mime[$e]}; $bytes=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($p); [int64]$len=$bytes.Length; $ctx.Response.ContentLength64=$len; $ctx.Response.Close($bytes,$true)}else{$ctx.Response.StatusCode=404; $ctx.Response.OutputStream.Close()}}catch{Write-Host $_}}
